rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Class definitions, regulation envelopes, scoring, and the bits that change year over year. Everything below is from public FIA / ACO documentation.
rules.classesDesc: Two classes share the 2026 grid. LMP2 left WEC after 2024.
rules.hypercarDesc: Top class. Two homologation paths competing under one BoP umbrella.
rules.lmhDetail: Le Mans Hypercar — bespoke chassis + bespoke ICE. Ferrari 499P, Toyota TR010, Peugeot 9X8, Aston Martin Valkyrie.
rules.lmdhDetail: Le Mans Daytona h — manufacturer's ICE on a spec chassis (Multimatic / Oreca / Ligier / Dallara) and spec Bosch hybrid kit. Cadillac, BMW, Alpine, Genesis.
rules.lmgt3Desc: Built on the Group GT3 platform. Two-class WEC since 2024 (replaced LMGTE).
rules.driverLineupDetail: Pro / Am rules — at least one Bronze or Silver driver per car, varying by season.
rules.tiresDetail: Single supplier (Goodyear) — same compounds as LMP2 to neutralize tire as a performance variable.
rules.envelopeDesc: Every Hypercar entry is homologated to fit inside this box. BoP slides individual cars within it, but the floor / ceiling are fixed.
rules.specMinWeightDetail: LMH and LMDh share the floor
rules.specFrontErsDetail: Hybrid only deploys above this speed
rules.specIceDispDetail: Open. 2.6 L V6 (Peugeot) to 6.5 L V12 (Aston) on the grid.
rules.specAeroDetail: One configuration per car after homologation; no track-specific bodywork.
rules.specErsMandateDetail: Required for any newly homologated car going forward.
rules.bopDesc: How the FIA equalizes a Toyota TR010 against an Aston Martin Valkyrie despite very different drivetrains.
rules.bopBody1: BoP is set in two phases. Pre-season: cars are simulated and wind-tunnel-tested at Windshear with a target performance window. Per-round: weight, max-power, and energy-per-stint adjustments are applied based on the most recent races.
rules.bopBody2Bold: From 2026 the FIA stopped publishing the per-round table.
rules.bopBody2: Numbers are now shared only with the competing teams — the stated rationale is that BoP figures without the underlying homologation data lead to outside misinterpretation. There is no public source for the actual settings.
rules.successDesc: A results-based mass penalty for top runners — already used in LMGT3 since 2024, expanded to Hypercar this year.
rules.successBody1: Cars carrying championship form into a round are weighted up; the lower-scoring rivals stay at base weight. The handicap is absorbed into the same private BoP table, so the per-car split isn't public.
rules.successBody2: Endurance week stands on its own — handicap is paused so the crown jewel of the calendar isn't decided by mid-season standings.
rules.pointsDesc: Two tables based on race length. Top ten finishers in class score; pole position adds one driver point.
rules.pointsFootnote: Endurance table applies at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, 8 Hours of Bahrain, and the Qatar 1812 km. Pole position adds +1 to every driver of the pole-sitting car.
rules.qualifyingDesc: Two-stage Hyperpole format since 2022. LMGT3 runs a separate Hyperpole on the same day.
rules.qualifyingStage1: open to all cars in the class. Top times on the board determine who advances.
rules.qualifyingStage2: top 10 (Hypercar) and top 8 (LMGT3) advance for a fresh shootout. Pole sitter takes the championship-points bonus and the right side of the grid.
rules.qualifyingFootnote: Cars that don't advance start in their stage-1 order behind the Hyperpole field.
rules.calendarDesc: Eight rounds across four continents. Three are endurance specials.
rules.calendarOthers: Imola, Spa, São Paulo, COTA, Fuji
rules.lifecycleDesc: How long the current rule set is locked in.
rules.lifecycleBodyPre: The LMH and LMDh frameworks were originally written through 2027 / 2028. In 2024 the FIA, ACO, and IMSA jointly extended both regulation sets through
rules.lifecycleBodyPost: — twelve years for LMH, ten for LMDh — to give manufacturers a stable runway and avoid a repeat of the late-2010s LMP1 collapse. There has been informal talk of a single converged platform for the next cycle, but nothing committed.
